question: The Village and Small Scale Industries Committee is also referred to as the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karve Committee.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Village and Small Scale** Industries Committee was set up in **1948** to study the problems of **small-scale industries** in India and suggest measures for their development.
 
• The committee was headed by **D.R. Karve**, a renowned social worker and educationist.
 
• The committee submitted its report in **1949,** which is also known as the **Karve Report.**
 
• The report highlighted the need for the** development of small-scale industries **in India and suggested various measures such as the **establishment of industrial estates, provision of financial assistance, **and **technical training to entrepreneurs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahalanobis Committee** was set up in** 1953** to suggest a plan for the **rapid industrialization** of India. 

 
 
• It is also known as the **Planning Commission**.
 
 
 
• **Munshi Committee** was set up in **1951.**
 
 
• Its aim was to study the problems of** small-scale industries** in India and suggest measures for their development.
 
 
 
• **Chakravarty Committee** was set up in **1985** to suggest measures for the development of small-scale industries in India.
 
 
• It is also known as the **High-Powered Committee** on **Urban** and **Rural Small-Scale Industries**.
